noOwnerNoSetterNoReceive.note: all 11 config values immutable (L95-115); no receive/fallback; payable router calls send value 0

noCallerChosenRecipient.note: value exits only to: V3 Router (BPT burn), Router02/pair (seed), newPooler (LP, skim, wrapped sUSDS), oldPooler (abort)

exitAndSeedOneShot.note: requires empty pair (reserves AND balances 0 after optional skim) and leaves it seeded; a second call reverts PairNotEmpty unless the pair is fully drained again, which UniV2 MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY (1000 LP burned to 0x0) prevents (ASSUMED canonical V2 pair)

approvalsResetToZero.note: BPT->v3Router reset L386; sUSDS/phUSD->Router02 reset L401-402; USDS->sUSDS reset L288

postConditionNoResidual.note: exitAndSeed requires zero BPT, sUSDS, phUSD on escrow (L273-275); wrapUsds requires zero USDS (L289). exitAndSeed does NOT require zero USDS (USDS is the wrapUsds path)

seedExact.note: addLiquidity mins == desired (L400); a==s && b==p (L404); LP delta == liq > 0 (L405-406); post reserves == (s,p) ordered by _sUSDSIsToken0 (L408-410)

exitFloorNotRecomputedOnChain.note: minAmountsOut only checked length==2 and each != 0 (L256-259); not compared to the live proportional share (by design, NatSpec L78-79). Effective floor is whatever the operator passes

seedPriceUnbounded.note: no check that s:p matches any reference price; whole-balance seed (L268-270) means stray sUSDS/phUSD donated to the escrow before the call change the seeded ratio (NatSpec L75-77 acknowledges)

constructor.signature: constructor(address operator_, address newPooler_, address oldPooler_, address v3Router_)
reads: oldPooler.pool() (SNAPSHOT of a mutable value - old pooler has setPool)
notChecked: v3Router is the genuine Balancer router
pair is the router factory's canonical pair (relies on UniPoolerV2 constructor having enforced it)
constructor.orderingConstraint: pair and UniPoolerV2 must exist before the escrow is deployed (constructor reads newPooler.pair() and pair.token0())

externalEntryPoints.function: exitAndSeed(ExitMode mode, uint256[] calldata minAmountsOut, uint256 deadline) returns (uint256 liquidity)
steps: _requireEmptyPair (L359): if reserves (0,0) and any pair token balance, pair.skim(newPooler) then re-read; revert PairNotEmpty if any reserve or balance remains (a SYNCED donation = permanent DoS of this path until the pair is otherwise emptied, which V2 cannot do once LP minted)
minAmountsOut.length == 2, each != 0; deadline in (now, now + 1 day]

_exit (L379): forceApprove(v3Router, bptIn); removeLiquidityProportional(bpt, bptIn, minAmountsOut, false, '') or removeLiquidityRecovery(bpt, bptIn, minAmountsOut); forceApprove 0; BPT balance must be 0
_seed (L393) with WHOLE sUSDS and phUSD balances: both > 0; Router02.addLiquidity(sUSDS, phUSD, s, p, s, p, newPooler, deadline)
externalEntryPoints.stateChanges: none in escrow storage (no storage); token balances only

externalEntryPoints.behaviour: whole USDS balance (>0) -> sUSDS.deposit(amt, newPooler); approval reset; require USDS balance 0

whole BPT, sUSDS, phUSD, USDS balances -> oldPooler via safeTransfer (each skipped if 0). Never reverts on empty. Recovery from oldPooler requires its owner (withdrawBPT / rescueERC20, not pause-gated)

externalEntryPoints.function: operator(), newPooler(), oldPooler(), v3Router(), bpt(), usds(), sUSDS(), phUSD(), pair(), uniRouter()

externalCalls.trustLevel: semi-trusted external, address unverified at construction
externalCalls.notes: Router burns the escrow's BPT by spending the ROUTER's allowance; pays tokens to msg.sender (escrow). Proportional exit reverts when pool paused; Recovery exit needs Recovery Mode (ASSUMED per mainnet semantics; fork test pins 'Vault PoolPaused')

externalCalls.trustLevel: untrusted STATE (anyone can transfer, sync, mint LP on a public pair)
externalCalls.notes: skim(newPooler) sends any unsynced donation to the new pooler

interfaceAbstraction.inboundCallbackSurface: none: no ERC721/1155/777 hooks; tokens are standard ERC20 (phUSD, sUSDS, USDS, BPT)

tokensHeld: BPT (from old.withdrawBPT(escrow, ...) - an owner tx on the OLD pooler, outside this contract)
custody.whoCanMove: only `operator`, and only to the fixed destinations above. No owner/rescue for arbitrary tokens: any token other than BPT/USDS/sUSDS/phUSD sent to the escrow is permanently stuck (VERIFIED)

trustAssumptions: operator (OWNER EOA) chooses timing, exit mode, minAmountsOut and deadline; slippage protection for both the exit and the seed price rests entirely on operator diligence (only zero-floors are rejected)
bpt snapshot equals old pooler's pool() at the time BPT is withdrawn into the escrow (old pooler's setPool is owner-only)

Funding the escrow (old.withdrawBPT / old.rescueERC20) and exitAndSeed are separate transactions; between them the escrow's balances are public and griefable by donation (seed ratio) but not withdrawable by strangers
UniPoolerV2 constructor guaranteed the pair is canonical and has token set {sUSDS, phUSD}
Uniswap V2 addLiquidity into a pair with reserves (0,0) and totalSupply 0 consumes desired amounts exactly (ASSUMED canonical Router02)
